title: 的 / 地 / 得 Step 3 · Look Left, Look Right: All Three
description: Now all three at once. Look right: a noun → 的, a verb → 地. Look left: a verb or adjective just before → 得.

points.title: Look right: 的 or 地?
points.summary: If the next word is a thing → 的; if it's an action → 地.
points.body:
- 认真**的**学生 (学生 = noun)
- 认真**地**学习 (学习 = verb)

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

points.title: Look left: 得
points.summary: Verb or adjective right before the blank, and a comment after → 得.
points.body:
- 学**得**很认真 (studies very seriously)
- 累**得**不想动 (so tired I can't move)

| | comes before … | pattern | example |
|---|---|---|---|
| **的** | a **noun** | describer + 的 + noun | 漂亮**的**衣服 · 我买**的**书 |
| **地** | a **verb** (how it's done) | describer + 地 + verb | 慢慢**地**走 · 认真**地**学习 |
| **得** | the **result** (after the verb) | verb / adj. + 得 + how | 跑**得**很快 · 累**得**不想动 |

**The trick:** look **right** — a noun next → 的, a verb next → 地. Look **left** — a verb or adjective just before → 得. (All three are read *de*.)

questions.explanation: Right: noun → 的, verb → 地 · Left: verb → 得.
notes: 笑 is a verb → 地.
After 写 → 得.
喊 is a verb → 地.
车 is a noun → 的.
After the verb 笑, a comment → 得.
大衣 is a noun → 的.

questions.prompt: Round 2 — 的, 地 or 得?
items: {孩子们|háizimen}{高高兴兴|gāogāoxìngxìng}＿{回家|huí jiā}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: One look left, one look right — every time.
notes: After the adjective 累, a result → 得.
After the verb 来: you came at just the right time → 得.
看 is a verb → 地.
回家 is a verb → 地.
电影 is a noun: the film I saw → 的.
主意 is a noun → 的.

questions.explanation: 得 always looks **back** at a verb or adjective.
notes: Before the verb → 地.
After the verb → 得.
After the verb → 得.
Whose? → 的.
After the adjective, a result → 得.
After the verb → 得.

questions.prompt: 「{她|tā}{高高兴兴|gāogāoxìngxìng}＿{唱|chàng}{了|le}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{好听|hǎotīng}＿{歌|gē}。」 Which pair fills the blanks?
questions.explanation: 高高兴兴**地**唱 (verb) … 好听**的**歌 (noun).
notes: 歌 is a noun → 的.
Swapped: 唱 is a verb (地), 歌 a noun (的).
得 would need a verb on its **left**.
questions.translation: She happily sang a beautiful song.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'She happily sang a beautiful song.'
questions.explanation: 她**高兴地**唱了一首**好听的**歌。 地 before the verb, 的 before the noun.
questions.translation: She happily sang a beautiful song.

questions.prompt: Build it: 'He ran so fast that I couldn't catch up.'
questions.explanation: 他**跑得**太快了，我追不上。 Verb + 得 + comment.
questions.translation: He ran so fast that I couldn't catch up.

questions.prompt: Why 「{认真|rènzhēn}{地|de}{学习|xuéxí}」 but 「{认真|rènzhēn}{的|de}{学生|xuésheng}」?
options: 地 is for people, 的 for things.
地 is for actions in the past, 的 for the present.
地 comes before a verb, 的 before a noun.
notes: 学生 is a person — and it takes 的.
Neither marks time.
In careful Chinese they're not: it depends on the next word.
